speakers.name: Alexandra Chen
speakers.title: Founder & CEO
speakers.session: From Idea to Launch: The First 90 Days
speakers.bio: Alexandra founded TechVentures in 2018 and has since helped over 100 startups launch successfully across Asia. She specializes in rapid prototyping and lean startup methodologies.

speakers.name: Marcus Wong
speakers.title: Partner
speakers.session: What Investors Look For in Student Founders
speakers.bio: Marcus has invested in over 50 startups across Southeast Asia, with a particular focus on student-led ventures. He's passionate about supporting the next generation of entrepreneurs.

speakers.name: Priya Sharma
speakers.title: VP of Product
speakers.bio: Priya has led product teams at some of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing companies. She's an expert in user research, product-market fit, and scaling products from zero to millions of users.

speakers.name: David Nguyen
speakers.title: Serial Entrepreneur
speakers.session: Lessons from Building and Selling Startups
speakers.bio: David has founded and exited three successful startups in the edtech and fintech spaces. He now mentors young entrepreneurs and angel invests in early-stage companies.
